---
title: "Stockbridge dampers"
---

::: {.callout-warning}
The stockbridge solvers are experimental and still changing: their interface
and their integration with the rest of slenderpy will be revised as they
mature.
:::

A stockbridge damper is modelled as a clamp carrying two inertial masses, each
on a planar cantilever messenger cable whose bending follows the Bouc-Wen law
section by section. The damper is built from
[](`~slenderpy.stockbridge.core.parameters.ClampParameters`),
[](`~slenderpy.stockbridge.core.parameters.MassParameters`) and
[](`~slenderpy.stockbridge.core.parameters.MessengerCableParameters`) into a
[](`~slenderpy.stockbridge.core.stockbridge.Stockbridge`).

Solvers, all re-exported by `slenderpy.stockbridge`:

- [](`~slenderpy.stockbridge.solvers.imposed_acceleration.solve_imposed_acceleration`):
  the clamp motion is imposed, each mass is solved independently;
- [](`~slenderpy.stockbridge.solvers.imposed_force.solve_imposed_force`): the
  force and moment at the clamp are imposed, masses and clamp are solved
  together;
- [](`~slenderpy.stockbridge.solvers.linearized.solve_linearized_imposed_force`):
  the same with linear springs and dashpots instead of the Bouc-Wen cables;
- [](`~slenderpy.stockbridge.coupling.beam_coupling.solve_dynamic_with_sb`):
  dampers attached to a beam span, coupled at every time step.

The script `examples/stockbridge.py` runs each of them; it is not rendered in
this documentation while the API changes.
